captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a modern smoothie-maker blender. It features a dark grey cylindrical base with a prominent teal and grey control dial on the front. Mounted on the base is a transparent, wide-mouthed plastic jug containing a grey multi-blade assembly at the bottom and a central vertical stirring rod. A dark grey lid with a teal top button seals the jug. The blade assembly rotates continuously on a vertical axis, and the lid twists on a revolute joint to lock and unlock.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery 3D model of a smoothie-maker blender. The assembly should include a cylindrical dark grey base with a control dial, a transparent wide-mouth jug, a central blade cluster that rotates continuously, and a locking lid with a central teal button that twists via a revolute joint.
captions.factory: The code constructs a base using a combination of cylinders and boxes, adding a dial on the front panel. The transparent jug is modeled as a hollowed lofted profile or tapered cylinder. The blade mechanism is constructed using intersecting thin boxes positioned at the bottom of the jug and attached via a continuous joint. The lid is modeled as a thin cylinder with a small central cylinder for the button and is connected to the top of the jug using a revolute joint.
